Name: ProsimCompanion
Author: ProsimCompanion
Description: Fire GSX/checklist commands and show live status from ProsimCompanion over its embedded web server. Requires the command API enabled in ProsimCompanion.

Actions.Name: GSX Service
Actions.Tooltip: Request (or retract) a GSX ground service and show its live state. Pick the service in the Property Inspector.

Actions.Name: Next Service
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the ground automation's next planned service; press forces it to run now.

Actions.Name: Checklist
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the active checklist and current item. Pick Advance or Restart in the Property Inspector.

Actions.Name: Flight Phase
Actions.Tooltip: Displays the current ProsimCompanion flight phase (display only).

Actions.Name: Voice Pause
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle: pause the First Officer's speech recognition while you talk to a real person (the FO still speaks). Red = paused.

Actions.Name: Cockpit Switch
Actions.Tooltip: A ProSim cockpit switch as a Korry button, toggle or knob: shows its live state and presses it. Pick the switch (configured in ProsimCompanion → Settings → Cockpit Switches) in the Property Inspector. Hold for a long press on a rotary knob.

Actions.Name: Camera View
Actions.Tooltip: Presses a vJoy button on the sim PC so a ChasePlane view bound to it changes. Pick the view (ProsimCompanion → Settings → Setup → vJoy relay) in the Property Inspector.

Actions.Name: Connection Health
Actions.Tooltip: ProSim / MSFS / GSX connection dots, plus pairing and command-API problems (display only).
